verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.tavily.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an agent-oriented summary and CLI usage. The docs also offer a 'Let your coding agent install and configure Tavily' flow through an agent-setup SKILL.md, and serve pages as raw .md endpoints that agents can ingest directly. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths return 404), and no independent community corroboration of agents actually using these docs.
